content_reproducibility: CSV content is deterministic for the generator version, schema version, seed, and row count. The manifest timestamp and ZIP container metadata are run metadata and may differ.

categorical_inconsistency.industry: Approximately 0.6% of Financial or Professional Services labels use a lowercase second word.

legitimate_outliers.enterprise_scale: Rare large enterprises arise from the upper employee, seat, and enterprise-price tails.
legitimate_outliers.reliability_incidents: Approximately 1.5% of records receive an elevated but bounded product error-rate event.

missingness.customer_satisfaction_score: Approximately 9% of records have no survey response.
